title: Saudi East-West pipeline — the outer bound of the officials' 3-5 week repair window closes
source: NEWS: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy shut the East-West crude pipeline on 2026-09-11 as a 'precaution' after drone strikes on 2026-09-10 damaged pumping stations in the Riyadh and Medina regions, including 'a major pumping facility'; two regional officials briefed on the matter told the Associated Press repairs 'could take three to five weeks', with one adding 'the line may work partially while teams carry out the repairs' (AP, carried by PBS NewsHour and Washington Times, both 2026-09-14; pbs.org fetched direct HTTP 200 on 2026-09-15). The DATE IS DERIVED, and that is the whole reason it is `estimate`: 2026-10-15 is five weeks from the 09-10 strike, the outer bound of an officials' RANGE relayed through the press, not a milestone anyone has announced. No Saudi government or Aramco statement naming a restart or completion date exists — Aramco declined to comment to the AP and the Saudi Center for International Communication said only that it was looking into the inquiry. Three independent estimates bracket the same window and none is a schedule: Reuters sources (2026-09-13, via gCaptain, fetched direct) said 'five to six weeks' or 'sooner... could resume pumping partially'; HSBC (2026-09-15, via Investing.com, fetched direct) modelled the line 'mostly offline for three to five weeks' and named a deficit window of 'mid-September to mid-October'; Goldman Sachs (2026-09-15, via BNN Bloomberg, fetched direct) put the published spread at 'very soon' to eight weeks. Corroborating market read, fetched DIRECT from polymarket.com/event/saudi-oil-pipeline-east-west-restarts-byptptpt on 2026-09-15: restart-by 2026-09-15 at 1% ($62,856), restart-by 2026-09-30 at 42% ($124,391), $187,247 total book, market end 2026-10-01, resolving on a Saudi government announcement that the pipeline is presently operating (partial or reduced capacity qualifies; statements about future or conditional resumption do not). A search summary relaying 63% for that same 09-30 leg did not reconcile with the direct read and was discarded for the second time in one day. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: Canonical entry written by this event's own never-assessed initial research (2026-09-15), promoting the single sibling proposal proposals/saudi-east-west-pipeline-repair-window-close-2026-10-15.from-jobs-2026-10-02.json (the 10-02 payroll's D-17 adjacency sweep, same day). Every field is carried forward unchanged; the source line is widened from the AP relay alone to the four independent estimates that now bracket the window, and the Polymarket read is refreshed to the direct 09-15 close-of-session numbers. WHAT THE DATE IS FOR, stated plainly so nobody reads more into it than it carries: it is the seam between two published ranges, not a scheduled release, a vote or an announcement. The AP's 3-5 weeks EXPIRES on 2026-10-15; Reuters' 5-6 weeks BEGINS there; HSBC's modelled deficit window ends 'mid-October'. A line still shut on 10-15 has therefore falsified every published estimate except Goldman's eight-week tail (2026-11-05) — that, and not any event on the day, is the information the date carries. Filed `medium`, not `high`, on the same reasoning the proposal gave: a single pipeline outage with a stated repair path is smaller than a scheduled macro print, and an event whose own date is an inference should not also carry a high-impact tier. `symbols: []` follows the convention every macro/geopolitical entry in this calendar uses (630 of 645 entries) — which leaves a KNOWN GAP recorded here rather than fixed in-lane: scripts/event-material-decide.mjs diffs prices only for symbols listed in THIS field, so an event whose entire content is the crude price has no price check in its deterministic screen. Adding a futures ticker (BZ=F) to a calendar that has only ever held US equity tickers is a schema-shaped change and belongs in its own PR, not inside a research ledger. Any lane that finds a Saudi government statement naming an actual restart or completion date should file THAT as the canonical entry and let this one go inert.
